events.description: Recorded a $10 million fleet restructuring charge in Q1 2015 to replace older, less cost-effective aircraft and removed seventeen 50-seat regional aircraft from the operating fleet.
events.source_quote: During the March 2015 quarter, we recorded a $10 million charge associated with our fleet restructuring initiative. We continue to restructure our domestic fleet by replacing a significant portion of our 50-seat regional flying ... During the March 2015 quarter, we removed seventeen 50-seat regional aircraft from our fleet as part of our strategy to restructure our domestic fleet.
events.section: Note 10. Restructuring and Other Items / Regional Carrier Expense

events.description: Restructured the fuel hedge portfolio by early settling certain hedges originally scheduled to expire in the second half of 2015, resulting in a cash payment of $302 million.
events.source_quote: During the March 2015 quarter, we restructured our fuel hedge portfolio by early settling certain 2015 hedges and deferring the settlement of a portion of the remaining positions. We paid $302 million to early settle contracts that were in a loss position and originally scheduled to expire in the second half of 2015.

events.description: Entered into fuel derivative transactions that effectively defer approximately $300 million of hedge settlements from the second half of 2015 into 2016.
events.source_quote: Additionally, we effectively deferred settlement of a portion of our hedge portfolio until 2016 by entering into fuel derivative transactions that will provide approximately $300 million in cash receipts during the second half of 2015 and require approximately $300 million in cash payments in 2016 (excluding market movements from the date of the transactions).

events.description: Repurchased and retired 9.3 million shares of common stock for $425 million under the $2 billion share repurchase program authorized in May 2014, bringing total program repurchases to 30.6 million shares at a cost of $1.3 billion.
events.source_quote: authorized a new $2 billion share repurchase program to be completed no later than December 31, 2016. During the March 2015 quarter, we repurchased and retired 9.3 million shares at a cost of $425 million bringing the total under this program to 30.6 million shares at a cost of $1.3 billion.
events.section: Capital Return to Shareholders / Item 2. Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities and Use of Proceeds

events.description: Declared a quarterly dividend of $0.09 per share on February 6, 2015, paid in March 2015, representing a total cash dividend distribution of $75 million.
events.source_quote: On February 6, 2015, the Board of Directors declared a $0.09 per share dividend for shareholders of record as of February 20, 2015. This dividend was paid in March 2015 and totaled $75 million.

events.description: Paid $260 million to reduce the principal on debt and capital lease obligations in Q1 2015, decreasing the total carrying amount of debt and capital leases to $9.6 billion from $9.9 billion.
events.source_quote: During the three months ended March 31, 2015, we generated $1.6 billion in cash from operating activities, which we used, along with existing cash, to ... reduce the principal on our debt and capital lease obligations by $260 million ... Our principal amount of debt and capital leases has declined from $9.9 billion at December 31, 2014 to $9.6 billion at March 31, 2015.
events.section: Financial Condition and Liquidity / Debt and Capital Leases
